<thought>The spectrum shows a dominant peak at m/z 211 with a secondary peak at m/z 212 (~12 % of the base) and a notable peak at m/z 213 (~33 % of the base). A ~1:3 intensity ratio for the M+2 peak is characteristic of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl = 75.8 %/24.2 %). No comparable M+2 peak of equal intensity (as expected for bromine) is present, and the smaller M+2 contributions typical of sulfur are not evident. Therefore, chlorine can be definitively identified from the isotope pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
